title: Every revision read in the tools uses git cat-file blob, so a deep Windows checkout reads it
goal: No non-test file in _tools/ reads a revision with git show REV:PATH: perfcheck.last_text, bl_check.KbAtHead.text, kblane.commit_paths, kbdecide.Context.deleted_version and old_text, and bl_cost.closed_gaps_by_item read through git cat-file blob REV:PATH (or another read that takes no path argument), as factdiff, kg_merge, kg_history, ql_deliver and kbingest already do, so a read that git show would fail with 'Filename too long' on Windows returns the content; the check plants a repository and refuses every git show REV:PATH with exit 128.

notes: Premise (2026-10-07): the check exits 1 with every reader returning None, empty or an error once git show REV:PATH is refused; commits 8f89bb8f and 1d6abb8d converted the other readers. kbdecide.old_text is not exercised by the check (it needs a fact key) and follows deleted_version's pattern.
